cards.title: See a code change as a map
cards.text: The new change map plugin shows a pull request as a diagram of the parts it touches and how they interact. Open any part's diff and screenshots, and comment on parts, lines or areas of a screen.
cards.alt: A change map review: the diagram of a pull request with the ticket form selected, and its screenshots before and after in the side panel

cards.title: Plugins teach your agents
cards.text: Your agents' pinrail skill now lists the plugins you installed and when to use each. A plugin can add a skill of its own, such as the change map's guide to mapping a change. A plugin copied from elsewhere adds its skill only after you allow it.
cards.alt: Settings, Plugins: the change map's details, with its skill reaching the connected agents
